message: Implemented `is_leap` using the standard Gregorian rule (divisible by 4, and not by 100 unless also by 400), using only builtins — no new definitions needed.
diff:
diff --git a/dates.py b/dates.py
index a00f476..9162323 100644
--- a/dates.py
+++ b/dates.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def is_leap(year: int) -> bool:
-    ...
+    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
